source: X API public reads (get_users_posts) on 11 Nov 2026. Official accounts: original posts since 1 Oct 2026. @elonmusk and @nextbigfuture: company-relevant posts only (SpaceX, Starlink, Starship, SPCX, Starmind, Grok/SI). Short off-topic replies were omitted. created_at is the original X timestamp (UTC).
missing: No public official X account found for CFO Bret W. Johnsen (checked 11 Nov 2026).
@xai now redirects in bio to @SpaceXSI; @SpaceXAI was not a live handle.
@grok is a very high-volume product account and is linked from the page rather than fully ingested.
